verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents automated workflows, ingestion workflows built with an AI Editor, webhook-triggered ingestion, and continuous monitoring. None of this evidence shows a user-configurable recurring schedule (cron, cadence or interval) for jobs or workflows. Webhook triggers are event-driven one-off actions, and continuous monitoring is a built-in platform behavior rather than user-scheduled recurring jobs, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
